provenance.notes: Literature baseline: a reproduction of a code published with arXiv:2609.30069, rebuilt from the authors' data repository (https://github.com/ultra-high-rate-qec/design-principles-data/blob/306b31d/codes/plain_fold/j4l10/parents/plain_v5_p62_c0.cpm).
